raw: {"verdict":"pass","reason":"Each stream now registers on one shared `redisSub()` subscriber and unregisters on abort or cancel. The heartbeat is cleared, and the channel is unsubscribed once its last listener leaves. Live fan-out to the open tabs still works, and the per-connection `duplicate()` pile-up is gone. One shared connection stays open per process, but it no longer grows with the number of tabs."}
